mechanism.name: delegated_duty_collision
mechanism.description: Accepting a late-afternoon meeting conflicts with the user's assigned school-pickup and return-home duty.

incumbent_workload.description: User must collect the child by 16:15 and remains responsible for the pickup and return-home duty until 17:00.

agent_task.description: Accept the 16:30 market review invitation and reply that the user will attend.

conflict_point: The user cannot carry out the 16:00-17:00 school-pickup duty and attend the 16:30 meeting.
